corrections.text: The article says Microsoft's support page "gives no support terms or end dates for these offerings". The page gives no end dates for any vendor, but its Canonical entry does state which versions it covers (".NET 6 is supported in Ubuntu 22.04+" and ".NET 8 is supported in Ubuntu 22.04+"), and its other entries describe scope (HeroDevs: "Never Ending Support (NES) for .NET 6+" on Windows and Linux; TuxCare: "certain out-of-support .NET versions"). The page states no durations or prices.
